test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an autobiography of a sportsperson?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Courage and Conviction**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Courage and Conviction**: An Autobiography by **General V. K. Singh**, published in **2013**, is a candid and compelling account of the life and career of a highly decorated Indian army officer.
 
• General Singh shares his experiences during various military operations, including the IPKF operation in Sri Lanka, the **1971 Bangladesh War** with Pakistan, **Operation Bluestar**, and anti-insurgency operations in Kashmir and the Northeast. He also sheds light on corruption scandals in the armed forces and the challenges he faced during his tenure as Chief of Army Staff.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Straight from the Heart:**-

 
 
• It is an Autobiography by **Kapil Dev**, published in 2004.
 
• It is a candid and inspiring account of the life and career of India's cricket legend.
 
• Dev shares his personal and professional journey, from his humble beginnings in Haryana to his meteoric rise as a cricket icon.
 
• He recounts his triumphs and failures, his relationships with teammates and coaches, and his unwavering passion for the game. 
 
 
 
• **The Race of My Life:-**
 
 
• It is an Autobiography by **Milkha Singh.**
 
• The book recounts Singh's early struggles, his passion for running, and his unwavering determination to succeed.
 
• It details his triumphs, including his gold medal wins at the 1958 Asian Games and 1958 Commonwealth Games, as well as his heartbreaking defeat at the 1960 Rome Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Playing It My Way:-**
 
 
• It is the autobiography of legendary Indian cricketer **Sachin Tendulkar**, chronicling his journey from his early days to **his 24-year international career**.
 
• It delves into both his on-field achievements and previously unshared aspects of his personal life.
